name: Production schedule rebuild
summary: When orders or forecasts change, the production planner gets a draft build schedule from open orders, work-centre capacity and material availability, with every overload and shortage listed, not quietly fixed. The planner checks feasibility and approves the changes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of manufacturing production planning: open orders placed in their due weeks, hours loaded onto work centres, materials drawn from a running balance, firm and forecast demand kept in separate layers, and every overload and shortage listed for the planner to decide.
